source: Owned town with normal unlocked recruitment stock
destination: Owned town connected by traversable explored land
charge: Normal existing per-unit quote including approved local discounts, plus once-per-shipment flat fee; consume shared family pool once at dispatch.
firstMovement: Next start of owning player turn, not immediately on dispatch
movementOrder: Stable caravan ID, one move budget each owner turn; serialize interruption.
settlement: Merge same creature IDs; deposit whole shipment atomically if it fits, else hold without loss.
interception: Enemy hero moves to attack caravan; cargo fights as hero-less defender army in existing terrain battle. Player defends manually in campaign.
lostDestination: Hold on safe current tile, notify and permit reroute to another owned reachable town without charging recruits again.
sharedTile: Friendly heroes and caravans may share world tile; expose actor picker. Battles lock actors; enemy cannot walk through a caravan without resolving encounter.
schedule: No movement during someone else’s decision. Dawn interruptions persist a continuation cursor.
